```{r functions}
run_gsea_seurat <- function(markers_df, gmt_path, output_gsea, output_deg) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(fgsea)
    library(BiocParallel)
    library(dplyr)
  })

  # Force serial execution to avoid BiocParallel crashes
  BiocParallel::register(BiocParallel::SerialParam())

  #-------------------------------
  # 1. Validate Seurat input
  #-------------------------------
  # Ensure the required columns from FindMarkers exist
  req_cols <- c("avg_log2FC", "p_val_adj")
  if (!all(req_cols %in% colnames(markers_df))) {
    stop(paste("Input must be a FindMarkers output containing:", paste(req_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  }

  # Remove rows with NA in the log2FC column
  markers_df <- markers_df[!is.na(markers_df$avg_log2FC), ]

  #-------------------------------
  # 2. Build ranking vector (Using log2FC)
  #-------------------------------
  # Extract avg_log2FC as the ranking metric
  rnk <- setNames(markers_df$avg_log2FC, rownames(markers_df))
  
  # fgsea prefers pre-sorted vectors
  rnk <- sort(rnk, decreasing = TRUE)

  if (length(rnk) < 1000) {
    warning("Ranking vector is small (<1000 genes). fgsea may lack statistical power. Ensure logfc.threshold = 0 in FindMarkers.")
  }

  #-------------------------------
  # 3. Load pathways
  #-------------------------------
  gmt <- fgsea::gmtPathways(gmt_path)

  #-------------------------------
  # 4. Run fgsea
  #-------------------------------
  gsea <- fgsea(
    pathways = gmt,
    stats = rnk,
    minSize = 0,
    maxSize = 500
  )

  gsea_df <- as.data.frame(gsea)

  # Flatten list columns (leadingEdge) for CSV export
  list_cols <- sapply(gsea_df, is.list)
  gsea_df[list_cols] <- lapply(gsea_df[list_cols], function(x) sapply(x, paste, collapse = ";"))

  #-------------------------------
  # 5. Write outputs
  #-------------------------------
  write.csv(gsea_df, output_gsea, row.names = FALSE)

  # DEG table (filtered for significance, padj < 0.1)
  deg_df <- as.data.frame(markers_df) %>%
    mutate(gene = rownames(markers_df)) %>%
    filter(markers_df$p_val_adj < 0.1)

  write.csv(deg_df, output_deg, row.names = FALSE)

  #-------------------------------
  # 6. Return objects invisibly
  #-------------------------------
  invisible(list(
    gsea = gsea_df,
    degs = deg_df,
    ranking = rnk
  ))
}

EnsIDReplace2 <- function(input, mapping_file = "C:/Users/rthalla/OneDrive - Loyola University Chicago/Zhang Lab/Ensembl_labels.csv") {
  #-----------------------------
  # 1. Validate inputs
  #-----------------------------
  if (!is.matrix(input) && !is.data.frame(input)) {
    stop("Input must be a matrix or data.frame with rownames.")
  }
  if (is.null(rownames(input))) {
    stop("Input must have rownames corresponding to Ensembl IDs.")
  }
  if (!file.exists(mapping_file)) {
    stop(paste("Mapping file not found:", mapping_file))
  }
  #-----------------------------
  # 2. Load mapping file
  #-----------------------------
  gene_mapping <- read.csv(mapping_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  required_cols <- c("gene_id", "gene_name")
  if (!all(required_cols %in% colnames(gene_mapping))) {
    stop("Mapping file must contain columns: gene_id, gene_name")
  }
  #-----------------------------
  # 3. Build lookup vector
  #-----------------------------
  id_list <- setNames(gene_mapping$gene_name, gene_mapping$gene_id)
  #-----------------------------
  # 4. Vectorized name replacement
  #-----------------------------
  old_ids <- rownames(input)
  
  # Strip version suffixes (e.g. ENSMUSG00000022584.2 -> ENSMUSG00000022584)
  stripped_ids <- sub("\\.\\d+$", "", old_ids)
  
  # Replace Ensembl IDs with gene names where available
  new_names <- id_list[stripped_ids]
  # For IDs not found in mapping, keep original (unstripped)
  new_names[is.na(new_names)] <- old_ids[is.na(new_names)]
  # Replace empty strings with NA
  new_names[new_names == ""] <- NA
  # Ensure syntactically valid + unique names
  new_names <- make.names(new_names, unique = TRUE)
  #-----------------------------
  # 5. Apply new rownames
  #-----------------------------
  rownames(input) <- new_names
  #-----------------------------
  # 6. Return modified object
  #-----------------------------
  return(input)
}
```

```{r process}
obj[["RNA"]] <- split(obj[["RNA"]], f=obj$orig.ident)
obj <- NormalizeData(obj)
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj)
obj <- ScaleData(obj)
obj <- RunPCA(obj)
obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, dims=1:30, reduction="pca")
obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = 2, cluster.name="unintegrated_clusters")
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims=1:30, reduction="pca", reduction.name="unintegrated_umap")

DimPlot(obj, reduction="unintegrated_umap", group.by=c("orig.ident", "unintegrated_clusters"))
```

```{r integrate}
obj <- IntegrateLayers(obj, method=HarmonyIntegration, orig.reduction="pca", new.reduction="integrated.pca")
obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, dims=1:30, reduction="integrated.pca")
obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = 0.5, cluster.name="harmony_clusters")
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims=1:30, reduction="integrated.pca", reduction.name="harmony_umap")

DimPlot(obj, reduction="harmony_umap", group.by=c("orig.ident", "harmony_clusters"))

obj <- JoinLayers(obj)
```

```{r identifying cell types}
rownames(template) <- c("HSC", "MPP1", "MPP2", "MPP3", "MPP4")
VlnPlot(obj, features=genelist)
DoHeatmap(obj, features=genelist)
```

```{r}
mat <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data"))

mat <- CMScaller::ematAdjust(mat)

ntp_res <- CMScaller::ntp(
  emat = as.matrix(mat),
  templates = template,
  seed = 123,
  doPlot = TRUE
)
table(ntp_res$prediction)

fdr_threshold <- 0.05

final_subtypes <- as.character(ntp_res$prediction)
final_subtypes[ntp_res$fdr > fdr_threshold] <- "Undetermined"

obj$subtype <- factor(final_subtypes, levels = c("HSC", "MPP1", "MPP2", "MPP3", "MPP4"))

# 4. Verify the distribution
print(table(obj$subtype))

obj_colors = c("cyan3", "olivedrab3", "orchid", "coral1")

# 5. Visualize on your UMAP
sigplot <- DimPlot(obj, group.by = "subtype", cols = mpp3_colors) + 
  labs(title = "LSK Predicted by NTP")
```
